source: Direct author statements in the development conversation

builds.name: Core 2.1 + input-prefader 0.2.0-experimental
builds.statement: everything checks out, all 7 points; on step 4: pressing stop twice with KEEP FX AWAKE cut out the tail completely right away

builds.name: Core 2.1 + digihealth 1.0 + digieq 1.0.2-experimental + input-prefader 0.2.0-experimental
builds.statement: 1 yes, 2 no - the fx are still awake after power on and the keep FX awake is ticked off (stock) though double pressing stop follows normal stock behaviour so not a major issue, the rest checks out just like build A

steps.2 unticked: silent after power-on until: no: input effects already awake at power-on; double STOP behaves as stock

builds.name: Control: Core 2.1 + digihealth 1.0 + digieq 1.0.2-experimental (without this module)
builds.statement: fx become awake at power on, but only after about 5-10 seconds

limitations: Pattern changes and sampling from the inputs were not tested.
Firmware was not read back from the device; the builds are identified by their SysEx hashes.
The power-on difference with Digi Health and Digi EQ also occurs without this module (control build); its cause in those modules is not identified.
Test time was reported as a total (about one to two hours of use), not per build.
packageParity: The isolated Docker build (toolchain image sha256:f5c85e78…4854) of commit 08ab54e6, packaged with scripts/package-elemod-recipe.mjs and linked with Core 2.1, gives the MAIN image and SysEx of both hardware-tested builds byte for byte (ddf836a3…40fa64 alone, a60b869f…ea6aa6 with Digi Health and Digi EQ).

usage.statement: ive been playing around with it for about an hour or 2 without any issues whatsoever.
